PACKAGE BODY KEY_CONTROL IS
PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY IS
BEGIN

:GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=1;

DECLARE
 FLAG1 NUMBER := 0;
 V_UPDATE NUMBER := 0;
 V_DELETE NUMBER := 0;
 V_INSERT NUMBER := 0;

 CURSOR C_FK(VROLE VARCHAR2) IS

 SELECT RL_SYS_UPDATE,RL_SYS_INSERT,RL_SYS_DELETE
 FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID = VROLE
 AND SYS_TYPE IN (5,6);

 CURSOR C_ROLES IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES SCUR
 WHERE USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCUR.ROLE_ID)
 UNION
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES SCGR,SC_USER_GROUPS SCUG
 WHERE SCUG.GROUP_ID = SCGR.GROUP_ID
 AND SCUG.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND SCUG.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND GR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCGR.ROLE_ID)
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1;
 vc varchar2(2000) ;
 vrol_password varchar2(200) ;
 V_ROLE VARCHAR2(2000);

BEGIN
 FOR J in c_roles LOOP
 FOR I IN C_FK(J.ROLE_ID)LOOP
 FLAG1 :=1;
 IF I.RL_SYS_INSERT =1 THEN V_INSERT := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_DELETE =1 THEN V_DELETE := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_UPDATE =1 THEN V_UPDATE := 1 ; END IF;

 END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF FLAG1 =1 THEN
 IF V_INSERT = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_DELETE =0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END;
 FK_DISPLAY;
END;

 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.V_DELETE = 0 THEN

END;

/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'OCR_VHCL_IMAGES_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,مسلسل داخلي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TIMER-EXPIRED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 THE_TIMER VARCHAR2(40) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 v_inactive_time NUMBER;
 V_msg_count NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'CHECKTIMEOUT' THEN
 v_inactive_time := Win_API_Session.Timeout_get_inactive_time;
 IF v_inactive_time >= 600 then
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Delete_Timer;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 1;
 BELL;
 EXIT_FORM (NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSIF v_inactive_time >= 360 then
 BELL;
 END IF;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_ERROR_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_MESSAGE_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'EDI_MSG' THEN
 for_edi_msg(V_msg_count);
 IF V_msg_count > 0 THEN
 BELL;BELL;BELL;BELL;
 :EDI_MSG.EDI_MSG_TXT := 'توجد رسائل بعدد '|| V_msg_count ||' مطلوب اتخاذ اجراءات عليها';
 TURN_MSG;
 end if;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'RETURN_EDI_MSG' THEN
 RETURN_MSG;
 END IF;
 WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG;
END;
